_README: TEMPLATE for the owner-only half of the training charter (#5087). Copy to config/training_charter.private.local.json (gitignored) and fill it, or put the same object in env TRAINING_CHARTER_PRIVATE_JSON, or at the owner-private S3 key config/coaching/training_charter.private.json. The repo is PUBLIC: no real value ever goes in a tracked file. lambdas/training/training_charter.py merges this over the public config/training_charter.json and reports private_loaded + private_keys; nothing under these keys is ever on the PUBLISHED_WHITELIST.
